UPDATE SSEAL SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} ,CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} ,CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} ,DEL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${DEL_FLAG }, DEL_FLAG ) ,SUBJECT = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SUBJECT }, SUBJECT ) ,SEAL_STATUS = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_STATUS }, SEAL_STATUS ) ,SEAL_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_TYPE }, SEAL_TYPE ) ,SEAL_MG_DEPT = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_MG_DEPT }, SEAL_MG_DEPT ) ,SEAL_MG_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_MG_USER_ID }, SEAL_MG_USER_ID) ,SUB_MG_DEPT = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SUB_MG_DEPT }, '' ) ,SUB_MG_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SUB_MG_USER_ID }, '' ) ,CAL_BASIS_131 = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${CAL_BASIS_131 }, CAL_BASIS_131 ) ,CAL_BASIS_132 = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${CAL_BASIS_132 }, CAL_BASIS_132 ) ,RECV_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${RECV_TYPE }, RECV_TYPE ) ,RECV_DATE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${RECV_DATE }, RECV_DATE ) ,RECV_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${RECV_USER_ID }, RECV_USER_ID ) ,RECV_ADDR = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${RECV_ADDR }, RECV_ADDR ) ,SEAL_DATE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_DATE }, SEAL_DATE ) ,SEAL_ATTACH_NO = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_ATTACH_NO }, SEAL_ATTACH_NO ) ,SEAL_USE_DEPT = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_USE_DEPT }, SEAL_USE_DEPT ) ,CONFIRM_DATE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${CONFIRM_DATE }, CONFIRM_DATE ) ,SEND_DATE = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEND_DATE }, SEND_DATE ) ,SEND_USER_ID = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEND_USER_ID }, SEND_USER_ID ) ,ELECTRON_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${ELECTRON_FLAG }, ELECTRON_FLAG ) ,REAL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${REAL_FLAG }, REAL_FLAG ) ,EXTERNAL_FLAG = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${EXTERNAL_FLAG }, EXTERNAL_FLAG ) ,SEAL_CATEGORY = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${SEAL_CATEGORY }, SEAL_CATEGORY ) ,PUBLIC_YN = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${PUBLIC_YN }, PUBLIC_YN ) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER}

/* SepoaSealManagementManager.doSelectSSEALList */ SELECT SEAL.HOUSE_CODE ,SEAL.COMPANY_CODE ,SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER ,SEAL.ADD_DATE ,SEAL.ADD_TIME ,SEAL.ADD_USER_ID ,SEAL.CHANGE_DATE ,SEAL.CHANGE_TIME ,SEAL.CHANGE_USER_ID ,SEAL.DEL_FLAG ,SEAL.SUBJECT ,SEAL.SEAL_STATUS ,SEAL.SEAL_TYPE ,SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT ,SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID ,SEAL.CAL_BASIS_131 ,SEAL.CAL_BASIS_132 ,SEAL.RECV_TYPE ,SEAL.RECV_DATE ,SEAL.RECV_USER_ID ,SEAL.RECV_ADDR ,SEAL.SEAL_DATE ,SEAL.SEAL_ATTACH_NO ,SEAL.SEAL_USE_DEPT ,SEAL.CONFIRM_DATE ,SEAL.SEND_DATE ,SEAL.SEND_USER_ID ,SEAL.SEAL_CATEGORY ,CASE WHEN SEAL.ELECTRON_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS ELECTRON_FLAG ,CASE WHEN SEAL.REAL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS REAL_FLAG ,CASE WHEN SEAL.EXTERNAL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS EXTERNAL_FLAG ,#DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, SEAL.COMPANY_CODE, SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS SEAL_MG_DEPT_NAME ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, SEAL.COMPANY_CODE, SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS SEAL_MG_USER_NAME FROM SDCAM DCAM INNER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON DCAM.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND DCAM.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND DCAM.CODE = SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE DCAM.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DCAM.USER_COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ( DCAM.USER_ID = ${session.ID} OR DCAM.USER_GROUP_CODE = ${session.DEPARTMENT} )

/* SepoaSealManagementManager.doSelectSealMappedPim */ SELECT SEAL.HOUSE_CODE , SEAL.COMPANY_CODE , SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEAL.SUBJECT , SEAL.SEAL_STATUS , SEAL.SEAL_TYPE , SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT , SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , SEAL.ELECTRON_FLAG , SEAL.REAL_FLAG , SEAL.SEAL_CATEGORY , #DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT1(SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, 'SC001', SEAL.SEAL_CATEGORY, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS SEAL_CATEGORY_NAME , UPIM.ITEM_NAME , UPIM.ITEM_CODE , UPIM.ITEM_TYPE , UPIM.SEAL_WIDTH , UPIM.SEAL_HEIGHT , UPIM.ITEM_NO FROM SSEAL SEAL INNER JOIN SUPIM UPIM ON UPIM.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND UPIM.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND UPIM.ITEM_CODE = SEAL.SEAL_TYPE WHERE SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = $S{MANAGE_NUMBER} AND SEAL.SEAL_TYPE IN($INS{SEAL_TYPE}) AND UPPER(SEAL.SUBJECT) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER($S{KEYWORD}), '%') AND SEAL.SEAL_STATUS IN($INS{SEAL_STATUS}) AND UPIM.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SEAL.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT = $S{SEAL_MG_DEPT}

/* SepoaSealManagementManager.doSelectSSUSE */ SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , MANAGE_NUMBER , USE_NUMBER FROM SSUSE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER} AND USE_NUMBER = ${USE_NUMBER}

/* SepoaSealManagementManager.doSelectSPMGT */ SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,CONT_NO ,CONT_GL_SEQ ,SEQ ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,USER_COMPANY_CODE ,USER_ID ,ACTION ,IP ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USER_NAME ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USER_DEPT_NAME FROM SPMGT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = '1' ORDER BY SEQ

/* SepoaSealManagementManager.doSelectCtrlCode */ SELECT BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID FROM SBALN BALN LEFT OUTER JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = BALN.CTRL_CODE WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE =${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND BALN.CTRL_CODE ='MANAGE_CONFIRM'

SELECT SIAD.SMR_NUMBER, PDSE.MANAGE_NUMBER, SIAD.ADD_DATE FROM SSIAD SIAD INNER JOIN SSIPD_SEAL PDSE ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = PDSE.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = PDSE.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = PDSE.SMR_NUMBER WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND PDSE.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${MANAGE_NUMBER} AND PDSE.ACCEPT_FLAG = 'N' AND SIAD.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS <> 'C'
